evidence.evidence_text: Chinese Spelling Correction (CSC) aims to detect and correct erroneous characters in Chinese texts.

Although efforts have been made to introduce phonetic information (Hanyu Pinyin) in this task, they typically merge phonetic representations with character representations, which tends to weaken the representation effect of normal texts.
